newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. 720 MW Four Corners coal-fired unit shut.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. 720 MW Four Corners coal-fired unit shut.

text.p: The 720-megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in Arizona was shut Monday night due to a boiler tube leak, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Tuesday.
A rough estimate is that the unit will be down for six days, they said.
The Four Corners plant also has a 750 MW unit, two 175 MW units and one at 200 MW, all of which are said to be operating normally.

Arizona Public Service Co, a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital Corp, has a 15 percents take in Four Corners' units 4 and 5, while Edison International's, Southern California Edison Co holds a 48 percent stake.
